title: Session-disjoint Slumbot public opponent-model feasibility
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Audited historical Slumbot action histories contain a session-stable, public-state-conditioned action distribution that can be learned substantially better than frequency baselines and later used only as one opponent in a diverse league, without imitating Slumbot into the hero policy.
material_change: Reconstruct bot decision states from the frozen Standard10 bridge fresh20k terminal histories, mask bot private cards, quantify exact/nearest physical-v6 action abstraction error, train a small public-state action model on sessions s01-s06, and evaluate untouched sessions s07-s08 against a street-frequency baseline.
baseline: The historical single Slumbot-imitation hero policy was still -18.5025 bb/100 and is a negative control. This experiment trains no hero and uses no hand outcomes as labels.

notes: No outcome labels, bot private-card features, hero updates, environment rollouts, or Slumbot network calls. Model is an opponent-distribution feasibility artifact only.

Initial run preserved in run/: 14 all-in showdown histories ended with one to three runout separators after ChipState was already terminal, causing the strict parser gate to reject them. Recovery permits only separators after terminal; action extraction semantics and split remain unchanged.

result.summary: Recovered all 20,000 audited hands into 58,338 public-state bot-action samples with zero replay failures; 99.8594% actions exactly matched physical-v6 slots and 99.9006% were within0.10 pot. On session-disjoint s07-s08, the learned model reduced NLL 34.03% and improved accuracy 14.86 points over a street-frequency baseline.
result.conclusion: Historical Slumbot behavior is predictable from public state without private-card or outcome leakage and is compatible with the physical-v6 abstraction. This admits an opponent-only contract smoke, not hero imitation or a strength claim.
result.next_step: Integrate the frozen public model as one bounded member of a diverse fixed opponent league, verify legal stochastic action sampling and replay, and run only a short matched hero learned-weight smoke before any larger training or fresh Slumbot evaluation.
